created.description: A file the call created (a Write of a new file).

truncated.description: Lines past what is carried were left out (the counts are whole).

old_start.description: Where the hunk starts in the old and new file; absent: not known.

FileEditHunk.description: What a file-editing tool call did (Claude Code's Edit, MultiEdit, Write, NotebookEdit), as the chat shows it: the file, its line counts, and its diff in hunks of unified-diff lines ("+added", "-removed", " context"). Taken from Claude Code's own patch of the result when the transcript has it (with line numbers and context, as its terminal shows), else from the call's arguments. Bounded: a chat entry carries it even when the call's payload is withheld from the wire.
